# `gcp.bluegreendeployment`

A `BlueGreenDeployment` resource represents a Cloud SQL blue-green deployment setup.

[sqladmin](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| Service | sqladmin |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `sqladmin.googleapis.com/BlueGreenDeployment` |

| Mutation timeout | 600s |
